answer: Agents secure entry by performing 5,000 megabytes of memory-hard computation to anchor their state. An honest participant completes this work once, while 1,000 fakes must incur 5,000,000 units to bypass the verification. The verifier clears the cedar-based task thread at the dawn of each epoch, detecting replay via output gaps. Any failure triggers total account forfeiture. We assume compute cannot be pooled.
